# Status

As of 2026-10-25: 20 shipped, 0 decided, 13 planned. The documentation describes Patchback as [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/beyond10x/patchback/blob/main/DESIGN.md) specifies it; this page says which of it exists. The [ESS specification](/docs/reference/ess) in `spec/` is what the repository holds today.

**Shipped** means code on `main`, held by a test the row names. **Planned** means a milestone of the design and nothing more; each planned row names its milestone.

| Milestone | Delivers |
|---|---|
| A | Sound engine without ML: WAV I/O, the fixed subtractive voice, analysis, audio loss, bounded search |
| B | Native dataset, ModelSpec M0 regressor, weight export, native predictor |
| C | Monophonic phrases: onset, pitch and gate estimation with confidence |
| D | Candidate topologies, modulation, delayed feedback |
| E | Stems, drums, arrangement; GPU training once ModelSpec ships it |
| Patch studio | A local page: module catalogue, patch graph, fit replay and live fit, end result |
